name: mixed-script
note: Mixed-script strings measured through the engine's per-glyph script-run fallback (src/canvas/script-fallback.ts, wired into SkiaCanvas.measureText). Chrome splits each string into script runs and resolves each run through fontconfig per-glyph (Latin stays in the primary when covered; Han falls back to Droid Sans Fallback; emoji falls back to Noto Color Emoji; a Latin run on a CJK primary falls back to Liberation Serif, the face fontconfig resolves missing Latin to on this machine). Reclassified from known-gaps; each string's residual delta is sub-pixel because both sides resolve the same per-run faces.
